primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in ALT at Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: ALT changed by −22.06 U/L with LIK066 30 mg, −30.41 U/L with 150 mg, and −8.77 U/L with placebo. Reported ANCOVA p-values were 0.075 and 0.005 for the LIK066 doses, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/43 with LIK066 30 mg, 0/43 with 150 mg, and 1/21 with placebo; no deaths.
